filter.description: Time window to count within. Must match the window the feed is showing, or the strip would offer a filter that returns nothing on this tab.

main.description: Category and mode counts for the events filter strip, aggregated in Postgres over the whole catalog (not tallied from a page of results). Lets the client offer only filters that will actually return something. Scoped by the same time window as getEvents, so an Upcoming strip counts upcoming events.
